cases.sql: CREATE TYPE ce AS(a integer,b text); PREPARE ce_false AS SELECT '(2,tail)'::ce WHERE false; PREPARE ce_n AS SELECT '(2,tail)'::ce IS NULL, '(2,tail)'::ce IS NOT NULL; PREPARE ce_o AS SELECT '(2,tail)'::ce; PREPARE ce_b AS SELECT ('(2,tail)'::ce).b; PREPARE ce_a AS SELECT ('(2,tail)'::ce).a; PREPARE ce_typ AS SELECT pg_typeof('(2,tail)'::ce); PREPARE ce_eq AS SELECT '(2,tail)'::ce = '(2,tail)'::ce; PREPARE ce_co AS SELECT coalesce('(2,tail)'::ce, NULL::ce) IS NOT NULL; PREPARE ce_one AS SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT '(2,tail)'::ce AS v) q GROUP BY v; PREPARE ce_drop AS SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT '(2,tail)'::ce AS v) q ORDER BY v; ALTER TYPE ce ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE numeric

CREATE TYPE datum_set AS(a text,b integer); PREPARE datum_union(datum_set) AS SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT '(hello,8)'::datum_set AS v UNION SELECT $1 AS v) q; PREPARE datum_distinct(datum_set) AS SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE n WHEN 1 THEN '(hello,8)'::datum_set ELSE $1 END AS v FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) q(n)) d; PREPARE datum_group(datum_set) AS SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) q(n) GROUP BY CASE n WHEN 1 THEN '(hello,8)'::datum_set ELSE $1 END; PREPARE datum_join(datum_set) AS SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) l(n) JOIN (VALUES (1),(2)) r(n) ON CASE l.n WHEN 1 THEN '(hello,8)'::datum_set ELSE $1 END = CASE r.n WHEN 1 THEN '(hello,8)'::datum_set ELSE $1 END; ALTER TYPE datum_set ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bytea

CREATE TYPE datum_bad AS (a integer,b text); PREPARE bad_d AS SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT '(2,tail)'::datum_bad AS v FROM (VALUES (1)) q(n)) d; PREPARE bad_d2 AS SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE n WHEN 1 THEN '(2,tail)'::datum_bad ELSE '(2,tail)'::datum_bad END AS v FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) q(n)) d; PREPARE bad_u AS SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT '(2,tail)'::datum_bad AS v UNION SELECT '(2,tail)'::datum_bad AS v WHERE false) d; PREPARE bad_u2 AS SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT '(2,tail)'::datum_bad AS v UNION SELECT '(2,tail)'::datum_bad AS v) d; ALTER TYPE datum_bad ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE numeric

BEGIN; ALTER TYPE datum_json ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE json
